Example global list initialisation 1:
Main Time=50 ms, coded Main Time = 98 (00001100010)b 
Group Time=5 ms, coded Group Time= 7  (00111) 
N_Factor =1;  (001)
Channels to be stimulated (1, 2, 5) 
Channel_Stim = (10011) bin  19dec
Channels with low frequency (5) 
Channel_Lf =  (10000)bin, 16dec

checksum=Main_Time+Group_Time+Channel_Stim+Channel_Lf+N_Factor
	= 98+7+19+16+1 =141 , (10001101)bin
mod(checksum,8)= (101) bin


Byte 0 -- 1 00 101 00 -- (0) SB, (00) Ident Nr, (101) Check sum, (00) N_Factor MSB
Byte 1 -- 0 1 000100  -- (0) SB, (1) Nfactor LSB, (000100) Channel_Stim 6 MSB
Byte 2 -- 0 11 00010  -- (0) SB, (11) Channel_Stim 2 LSB, (00010) Channel_Lf 5 MSB
Byte 3 -- 0 000 0000  -- (0) SB, (000) Channel_Lf 3 LSB, (00) Not in use, (00) GT 2MSB 
byte 4 -- 0 111 0000  -- (0) SB, (111) Group_Time 3 LSB, (0000) Main_Time 4 MSB
byte 5 -- 0 1100010   -- (0) SB, (1100010) Main_Time 7 LSB
